clues.it: Elena era accanto a uno sgabello.
Sergio era nella 9ª colonna e nella 3ª riga.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 9th column and in the 3rd row.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 8ª colonna e nella 4ª riga.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 8th column and in the 4th row.

clues.it: Marta era nella Torre del Mago.
clues.en: Marta was in the Wizard Tower.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 4ª colonna e nella 6ª riga.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 4th column and in the 6th row.

clues.it: Luca era nella 7ª riga e accanto a un'armatura.
clues.en: Luca was in the 7th row and beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: Giada era in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Giada was in a different room from Fabio.

clues.it: Olga era nella 9ª riga e accanto a un forziere.
clues.en: Olga was in the 9th row and beside a treasure chest.

clues.it: Carla era l'unica persona su della paglia e accanto a un gargoyle.
clues.en: Carla was the only person on a bed of straw and beside a gargoyle.

clues.it: Bruno era nella stessa stanza di Olga.
clues.en: Bruno was in the same room as Olga.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a un gargoyle, ma non era accanto a un'armatura.
clues.en: Irene was beside a gargoyle, but was not beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 12ª colonna, nella 14ª riga e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 12th column, in the 14th row and north of Nino.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 10ª colonna e nella 16ª riga.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 10th column and in the 16th row.

steps.it: Solo Dario può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 15ª è sua.
steps.en: Dario is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 15th is theirs.
